SELECT b.userCode,b.gender,b.user_check_time as serviceWaitingTime from( SELECT a.* from ( select regin.user_code as userCode,regin.gender,json.user_check_time from yh_question_check_json2 json left join yh_user_reginfo regin on json.user_code=regin.user_code ORDER BY json.user_check_time DESC) a GROUP BY a.userCode) b
where DATEDIFF(NOW(),b.user_check_time)%#{nowdatetime}=0 and to_days(b.user_check_time) != to_days(now())
